notes.title: PLEASE SMILE - Demo and Shoppage live!
notes.content:
Hi!

I’m Red Jellyfish, and Please Smile is my debut game as a solo developer!

It’s crucial that you get a glimpse of the game—completely free!

The Please Smile demo will remain available indefinitely, even outside of festivals. Take this opportunity to check it out for yourself. And if you enjoy it, add Please Smile to your wishlist! Every bit of support helps. =)

If you’re wondering about the price and how much content to expect:

Please Smile aims to provide a unique gameplay experience
Playtime ranges from 3 to 20 hours—testers took 20 hours, but I say it can be done in 3.
The full version contains 60 rooms.
The game is already in gold status—meaning I could shadow-drop it anytime >.>
The price is around $10 / €10—and comparable in other currencies.
Please Smile has no dialogues or substantial in-game text.
There are no interruptions either. It’s pure gameplay, so what are you waiting for? Download the demo and add Please Smile to your wishlist!
